about: .XN--WGBH1C is a country-code top-level domain (ccTLD) in the DNS root zone. It is designated for Egypt. The IANA root zone lists the registry manager as National Telecommunication Regulatory Authority - NTRA. Registration policies (who may register, local presence, pricing) are set by the registry and its accredited registrars — not by IANA.
